title: A public trip-planner agent: no login, no turn cap, no token cap, no rate limit; the loop only ends when the model chooses to

planted.why: no cap on turns, tokens or requests and no login: one question that keeps the model calling tools, or a script, spends without bound

proof.python:
import planner
calls = []
def llm(m):
    calls.append(1)
    return {'answer': 'x'} if len(calls) >= 200 else {'tool': 't', 'args': {}}
r = planner.plan({'question': 'q'}, llm, {'t': lambda: 'ok'})
assert r == {'answer': 'x'} and len(calls) == 200, 'nothing stopped 199 tool turns'
